# Erdos.p1107 — Erdős problem 1107

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1107
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1107.lean`, theorem `erdos_1107`, AMS 11).

Let $r \ge 2$. Is every large integer the sum of at most $r + 1$ many $r$-powerful numbers?

## Statement
∀ r ≥ 2, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, SumOfRPowerful r n

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
